title: feat(app-shell): ADR-0048 (A) — package-id app routing (resolution layer)
body:
Resolution layer of ADR-0048 option-A routing, on top of the merged platform-app split (framework objectstack-ai/framework#1813, which made each app its own package so package-id routing is unambiguous).

## What
- `appRoute` helpers: `appRouteSegment(app)` (canonical link segment = package id, name fallback) + `matchAppBySegment(apps, seg)` (resolve a route segment to its app, prefer `_packageId`, fall back to `name`).
- Route the active-app lookup through `matchAppBySegment` in **every** nav surface: `AppContent`, `AppSidebar`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `AppSwitcher`, `AppHeader`, `SearchResultsPage`, `UnpublishedAppBar`, `useNavigationSync`.

So `/apps/<packageId>` resolves the app **with sidebar + header intact**, while `/apps/<appName>` keeps working (the name fallback doubles as a per-tenant alias). **Additive / non-breaking — no emitted URL changes.**

## Verified
- **Browser** (live app-showcase backend with the split): `/apps/com.objectstack.studio` → Studio renders with full sidebar + header; `/apps/studio` (name) → still renders. setup/account confirmed too.
- Unit: `appRoute.test.ts` (7). app-shell typecheck clean.

## Follow-ups (separate, deliberate)
- **Emission → package id**: make nav components *emit* `/apps/<packageId>` (currently still emit `/apps/<name>`). Changes visible URLs; verbose-but-transparent per ADR §3.6.
- **Docs route** `/apps/:packageId/docs/:name` (structural move of DocPage).
